Wrote `benchmark/writing/pin-drift-0218.md` (headings Failures, Drift table, Recommendation). Measurement only. No checker, pin map, verification.json or input was changed, nothing was re-pinned, and benchmark_ready stays false. The verification command printed OK.

- I re-ran all 10 checkers as `python3 -I -B`. Full outputs are in `.session/artifacts/<checker>.py.out`. I read the 0115 output (303 lines) and the 0117 output (777 lines) in full.
- Classification: 4 `pin-drift-only` (0115, 0117, 0119, 0121) and 6 `unknown` (verify_method, check_c1_challenges_0125, check_c1_f1_0129, check_human_c1_0130, check_wp1_key_0123, check_integrity_0128). The six stop at their first failing pin, so later checks never ran. I found 0 `content-drift`.
- 0115: `package_errors` are only `input-blob` and `input-hash`. I recomputed its 39 `read_input_manifest` entries against the disk. 37 match, and only `benchmark/preparation.json` and `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` differ. All 30 counterexamples were rejected.
- 0117 adds two `review-source-pin` errors for the same two files. `predecessor_package_unchanged` is false, and I did not trace why.
- Cause of the drift: re-pins of challenge fixtures, `score.py` and `results/challenges.json` in the 11 commits after fc02ca67. They run from 8cb25137 (#758) to 4eef3934 (#905). The two index files and the two C1 pin manifests changed. The Drift table gives pinned and current hashes and the commits. All commit dates are 1970-01-01, so I give commit ids only.
- Not found: the file behind `cab26fce…` (0123 PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256) and `649b7138…` (0121 PRE). Neither matches any `git log` blob of the two index files.

## Discoveries
- The 0126 manifest sits at `benchmark/writing/reviews-0128/c1-artifact-manifest-0126.json`, not `benchmark/writing/`. It is 28788 bytes against a pin of 28787 (`check_integrity_0128.py:13`).

## What next
The Policymaker or owner decides whether to re-pin. A read-only replay of the 6 `unknown` checkers on the historical bytes (`git show fc02ca67:benchmark/preparation.json` and `2033c33f:benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`) would show whether anything beyond pins fails. I did not run it. Don't repeat the 10 checker runs or the hash walk.
